name: @penguinharness/rsiagent
description: RSIAgent for PenguinHarness: Curriculum, Actor and Verifier agents run broad-then-deep exploration and freeze causal memory for held-out reuse (arXiv:2609.15364).
author: KeBbboy

penguin.title: RSIAgent
penguin.description: RSIAgent (arXiv:2609.15364) as a PenguinHarness plugin: Curriculum, Actor and Verifier agents explore an environment broad-then-deep, consolidating verified experience into a versioned frozen causal memory that held-out tasks reuse without updates. Includes a protocol core with memory-integrity invariants and a restricted-container verifier boundary. Not the original runtime; deviations are disclosed in the Skill.
penguin.description_zh: 将 RSIAgent（arXiv:2609.15364）实现为 PenguinHarness 插件：由 Curriculum、Actor、Verifier 三个智能体执行先广度后深度的环境探索，把验证过的经验固化为带版本、可校验的冻结因果记忆，供留出任务在只读条件下复用。附带协议核心（记忆完整性不变量）与受限容器验证器边界。非原论文运行时的完整复现，偏差在 Skill 中如实披露。
penguin.short_description: Broad-then-deep exploration and frozen causal memory.
penguin.short_description_zh: 先广后深探索，冻结因果记忆。

quick_start.prompt: Use the rsiagent skill to run broad-then-deep exploration over the supplied training tasks, freeze the resulting causal memory, and evaluate held-out tasks with the frozen memory read-only. Report deviations from the paper and their reasons.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 使用 rsiagent 技能，对给定的训练任务执行先广后深探索，冻结得到的因果记忆，并在只读条件下用冻结记忆评估留出任务。如实报告与论文的偏差及原因。
